patient_profile.diagnosis_summary: Adult female with menorrhagia (heavy menstrual bleeding), a uterine fibroid, and an intrauterine endometrial polyp identified on ultrasound.

request.requested_disposition: Coverage approval for Myfembree for treatment of heavy menstrual bleeding

denial_rationale: Insurer denied coverage for Myfembree, stating the submitted records did not establish medical necessity for this indication given the patient's diagnostic findings and treatment history.

known_facts.text: Patient has a documented history of a prior adverse effect on medroxyprogesterone.
Patient reports trying samples of Oriahnn with a reported adverse effect, but had no prescription for it on record.
Pharmacy claims show prior prescriptions for Motrin 800 mg, Naproxen 500 mg, and medroxyprogesterone 100 mg tablets.
Patient reports a 2-year history of intermittent bleeding, irregular periods, and left lower quadrant pain, with diagnoses of fibroid, menorrhagia, and adenomyosis.
Pelvic ultrasound showed a normal-size uterus with a solitary 4.4 cm intramural left-sided fundal fibroid, a possible 7 mm intrauterine polyp, and a 2.4 cm endometrial polyp.

treatment_or_claim_history.description: Trial of medroxyprogesterone; adverse effect reported.
Trial of Oriahnn samples (no prescription on record); adverse effect reported.
Pharmacy claims for Motrin 800 mg and Naproxen 500 mg on file.
Pelvic ultrasound performed; findings as above.

available_evidence.description: Prescriber records of medroxyprogesterone and Oriahnn trials
Documentation of trial/failure of oral contraceptives, oral progesterone, or NSAIDs specifically for heavy bleeding

unknowns: Whether the intrauterine/endometrial polyp has been separately evaluated for surgical removal.
Exact plan formulary/step-therapy language applicable to Myfembree for this diagnosis.
